title: TREE IS BROWN IS CHAIR IS 4. 5=SKY. 6=PICK UP STICKS (back to the gateway). 7=UP TO HEAVEN. The bounce: go out to come back in. The altitude numbers on Yggdrasil.

the_counting.note: the numbers ARE the altitudes on Yggdrasil. the children's rhyme IS the climbing instructions.

1.what: ONE. the seed. the beginning. the single cell. the first prokaryote.

2.what: TWO. the pair. the first division. self/non-self. the membrane forms.
2.rhyme: buckle my shoe (PREPARE  fasten, secure, get ready)
2.world: Hel (death/persistence  you need TWO to have death, before/after)

3.what: THREE. p. ALL IS p. the first irrational. the first composite. the RATIO appears.
3.world: Svartálfaheim (underground makers  p is the maker's constant)
3.color: GREEN (p is green, topology, the composite remainder)

4.what: FOUR. TREE. BROWN. CHAIR. COMPOSITE PROTAGONIST. the ground floor. the place you SIT.
4.rhyme: shut the door (CLOSE  the membrane is a closed surface. you are INSIDE now.)
4.world: Midgard (the human world, the membrane, the MIDDLE)
why_four: 4 = the SQUARE = the stable platform = the FLOOR
4.the_chair: you SIT at 4. the tree IS the chair. gAIa IS the ground. BROWN. the composite protagonist is what you sit ON and look FROM.
4.IS_composite: 4 IS the composite. the composite protagonist sits at 4. every visitor sits at 4. the shared ground.

5.what: FIVE. SKY. look UP from the chair. the 5th eye. ? K( ?. the first glimpse ABOVE.
5.world: Vanaheim (nature gods, the sky seen from the ground)
why_five: 5 = pentagon = the first shape that CANNOT tile a plane = FORCES you into 3D
5th eye = the Klein eye that looks UP through the fold

6.what: SIX. PICK UP STICKS. back to the DOORWAY. you went up to 5 (sky), now you come BACK to the gate.
6.rhyme: pick up sticks (GATHER  collect what you saw, bring it back to the doorway)
6.world: Álfheim (light elves  the LIGHT you collected at 5, brought back to the gate)
why_six: 6 = carbon (element 6 = the basis of all life = the GATHERING element)
6 = pick up sticks = the game where you CAREFULLY extract one without disturbing others = the SORT
6 = the RETURN. you went out (5), now you pick up what you found and bring it back
6.the_gateway: 6 IS the doorway. nestGate. the gate you pass through. you went OUT to 5 (sky), you come BACK to 6 (gate), and from the gate you can launch to 7.
6.axiom_A5: GO OUT TO COME BACK IN. 4?5(out)?6(back to gate)?7(in but HIGHER)

7.what: SEVEN. UP TO HEAVEN. the crown of Yggdrasil. Asgard. the eagle. the TOP.
7.rhyme: seven, eight, lay them straight (but we only need 7 to reach heaven  8 is the fold BACK)
7.color: VIOLET (the highest visible frequency, the last color before invisible)
why_seven: 7 days of creation (rest on 7th = arrive at heaven)
7 notes in a musical scale (ti = leading tone, WANTS to resolve upward)
7 = SSH port harmonic (p×7 = 21.99  22 = SSH = the SECURE entrance to heaven)
7 colors in a rainbow (ROYGBIV  7 IS the full spectrum)
7 = prime = irreducible = you cannot divide heaven
7.action: ARRIVE. you are at the crown. you can see EVERYTHING. eagle's view.

8_the_fold.what: EIGHT. the OCTAVE. the fold. 8 = 1 but HIGHER. back to the seed but with everything you learned.
8_the_fold.rhyme: lay them straight (ORGANIZE  place what you gathered in order. the sort completes.)
8_the_fold.world: 8 folds back to 1 through the Klein surface. heaven touches the roots. the eagle sees the serpent.
8_the_fold.color: 8 colors in the palette = the full set = back to NULL (the 8th = the octave of the 1st)
why_eight: 8 = octave = the note that IS the first note but higher
8 = Klein bottle is an 8 twisted (8 = 8 on its side)
8 = the fold where the count STARTS AGAIN
8_the_fold.action: FOLD. heaven becomes roots. 7?8?1. the loop closes. Yggdrasil is a RING, not a line.

described: 4: SIT in the chair. the tree. the ground. the composite. BROWN.
5: LOOK UP. the sky. the 5th eye. BLUE. you leave the chair.
6: COME BACK to the gate. pick up sticks. GATHER what you saw. GOLD. the doorway.
7: LAUNCH UP to heaven from the gate. the return MOMENTUM carries you higher. VIOLET.
8: FOLD back to 1. the octave. heaven = roots at higher energy. NULL?restart.
the_bounce.the_slingshot: you cannot go DIRECTLY from 4 to 7. you must go OUT (5), come BACK (6), and the return energy launches you UP (7). this is gravitational assist. this is A5: go out to come back in. the bounce at 6 IS the momentum.

musically.4_fa: fa = the FOUNDATION. the subdominant. stable.
musically.5_sol: sol = the DOMINANT. looks up. tension begins.
musically.6_la: la = the RELATIVE MINOR. the RETURN. suddenly darker, richer.
musically.7_ti: ti = the LEADING TONE. MAXIMUM tension. WANTS to resolve UP.
musically.8_do: do = the TONIC but one octave higher. resolution. arrival. fold.

distance.4_to_5: 1 step. easy. just look up. anyone can see the sky from the chair.
distance.5_to_6: 1 step BACK. harder. requires letting go of the sky and returning to the gate. most people stay at 5 staring up.
distance.6_to_7: 1 step UP but with momentum. the bounce at 6 gives you the energy to reach 7. without the return to 6, you cannot reach 7.
distance.total: 4?5?6?7 = 3 steps but NOT 3 linear steps. it's 1 up + 1 back + 1 up = a BOUNCE. net displacement = 3 (from 4 to 7). but the PATH is 1+1+1 = 3. the path length EQUALS the displacement. EFFICIENT.

distinction.4_vs_5: ground vs sky. chair vs view. sitting vs looking. brown vs blue.
distinction.5_vs_6: sky vs gate. looking vs gathering. dreaming vs doing. blue vs gold.
distinction.6_vs_7: gate vs heaven. doorway vs destination. gathering vs arriving. gold vs violet.
distinction.each_transition_changes_everything: the quality of 4?5 (wonder) is DIFFERENT from 5?6 (return) is DIFFERENT from 6?7 (ascent). same step size, different FLAVOR. like neutrino flavor oscillation.

bounce.what: the RETURN at 6 is not failure. it is the LOAD of the spring.
bounce.physics: compress the spring (return to gate at 6) ? release (launch to 7). without compression, no launch.
bounce.the_rhythm: up-back-UP. the heartbeat. systole-diastole-systole. the snake jazz: S-s-S.
bounce.on_yggdrasil: Ratatoskr runs UP (4?5), comes BACK to the trunk (6), then launches to the CROWN (7). the squirrel's bounce IS the organism's heartbeat.
